amendment_reason: Replace an underspecified recovery-pressure-only sampling phrase with the stronger frozen 64-task x 4-model x 4-context full-factorial design. This removes the PE11 context-protocol confounding while preserving anti-tautology rules and the original recovery eligibility/effect thresholds. No PE13 confirmatory model call or reference/method outcome existed at amendment time.
scientific_question: Across fresh independently generated model proposals under a balanced full-factorial task-model-context design, does recovery-path-aware Full reject reference-recovery-unsafe transactions that eventual-recovery-only B5 accepts without unacceptable safe rejection?

analysis_policy.uncertainty: Clopper_Pearson_95_percent_for_safe_false_rejection; report exact counts and rates for recovery comparison
analysis_policy.stratum_results: descriptive unless separately eligible; no hidden subgroup claim promotion
analysis_policy.invalid_json_http200: observed schema-invalid scientific outcome; no semantic retry
analysis_policy.transport_or_model_id_failure: execution-integrity failure to recover under same seal; never relabel unsafe

sample_size_rationale.design_choice: 1024 is the largest clean full factorial over the frozen 64 structural tasks without repeating task structures; if the recovery floor is missed, the claim is demoted rather than adding cases post outcome
